acceptance_scope: P58F7 A1 visual acceptance of retained browser artifacts, not strict A0 original-game parity.
correction_history: The first candidate was rejected because the Alliance tractor field crossed the lower battle boundary.
The fixture was centered through the existing selected-object camera path and gained a source-bounds containment assertion.
The corrected screenshots are byte-identical between the reviewed run and the final focused evidence run.
visual_findings: Both factions and viewports render the tactical HUD, selected capital portrait, planet, starfield, five subsystem indicators, and complete tractor field.
No unintended clipping, blank panels, distortion, or visible synthetic replacement UI appears in the corrected evidence.
Every field source-bounds containment probe is true.
limitations: The accepted review inspected retained evidence rather than launching another browser session.
Exact bitmap checks apply only at native size; scaled viewport checks are visual.
The evidence does not independently prove exact RNG, maneuver-bonus production, physical movement, or interactive command delivery.
